findVerse.name: Scripture
findVerse.label: on the way: the Scripture tab in the top bar

findVerse.name: Passage
findVerse.label: the Passage box (Enter lays the passage out as slides; nothing goes live)

show.label: the first slide of the passage (clicking a slide puts it on the audience output)

clear.label: F10 clears the slide content from the audience output

next.label: Right arrow steps the live passage to its next slide

previous.label: Left arrow steps the live passage back
